evidence.claim: Prefix comparison shows five of six non-initial updates append at EOF; the round-1 update is not a prefix-preserving append.
evidence.command:
git log --format='%H' -- LOG.md | while IFS= read -r c; do p=$(git rev-parse "$c^" 2>/dev/null) || { printf '%s INITIAL-LOG.md-ADDITION
' "$c"; continue; }; if git cat-file -e "$p:LOG.md" 2>/dev/null; then n=$(git show "$p:LOG.md" | wc -l); if git show "$c:LOG.md" | head -n "$n" | cmp -s <(git show "$p:LOG.md"); then printf '%s APPEND-PREFIX-PRESERVED (%s parent lines)
' "$c" "$n"; else printf '%s FAIL-NOT-PREFIX (%s parent lines)
' "$c" "$n"; fi; else printf '%s INITIAL-LOG.md-ADDITION
' "$c"; fi; done
